project.title: Techxtreme Portfolio Light Mode
project.description: Premium light mode design system and components for Techxtreme Portfolio

principles.colors: Sophisticated, muted colors inspired by natural elements - sage green, dusty peach, light blue, off-white
principles.shadows: NO harsh black shadows - use primary color (#7B9B8C) at 10-15% opacity for shadows
principles.glassmorphism: Subtle frosted glass effects with light backgrounds, translucent overlays with warm undertones
principles.typography: Sora for headlines (modern, geometric), Inter for body text (highly legible), Manrope for labels (rounded, friendly)

screens.title: Premium Navigation Bar
screens.description: Sophisticated glassmorphism navigation with frosted glass effect, centered TECHXTREME logo, horizontal menu with smooth hover animations
features: Smooth hover states with gentle transitions
Subtle border highlights and depth shadows

screens.title: Premium Hero Section
screens.description: Large hero area with glassmorphism card overlays, professional headshot, animated background, and sophisticated glass containers
features: Floating professional headshot with glass frame

screens.title: Portfolio Gallery Cards
screens.description: Grid of premium glassmorphism project cards with hover effects, tech stack badges, and sophisticated animations
features: Tech stack badges with glass effects

implementation.shadowStrategy: Use primary color (#7B9B8C) at 10-15% opacity instead of black shadows
implementation.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/10-40 and translucent borders
implementation.animations: Smooth transitions with gentle scale transforms and elevation changes
implementation.typography: Sora for headlines, Inter for body, Manrope for UI labels
